notation: Independently authored claim fragments. Each case records native uniform, assume, and undefined results (or the kind's native error), plus user_sgprs. Instruction claims are keyed by instruction index and edge claims by edge:FROM->TO. messages are native assume-failure and held-value formatting results for the explicit inputs in this generator.

; uniform: s:x#9[3]x7 (unplaced scratch)
	s_nop 6
